values.note: Mecosta County 2026 rate card, School Section Lake: water + electric $35 Mon-Thu, $40 Fri-Sun, $50 holiday ($650 monthly); full hookup $40 / $45 / $55 ($900 monthly). No resident/non-resident difference. A $10 daily vehicle permit is required in addition to camping fees (the Michigan Recreation Passport is not valid); $5 non-refundable processing fee per site reserved.

fees.source: https://www.mecostacountyparks.com/uploads/9/2/6/3/92633552/2026_rate_card.pdf (School Section Lake Park rows) + https://www.mecostacountyparks.com/rules-rates--cancellations.html ('Vehicle permits are required for park entrance and in addition to camping fees', 'Daily Vehicle Permit - Brower & School Section ... $10 per day') + online-reservations.html ('$5 non-refundable processing fee per individual campsite'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 205 campsites, 103 of them seasonal (2025); 5 cabins plus two modern cabins and a family group camp.

note: Mecosta County park on School Section Lake (9003 90th Ave), with a large sand swimming beach, a historic one-room schoolhouse, boat rentals, disc golf and a family group camp. --Claude
summary: Recorded 2026 fees $35 (water/electric weekday) to $45 (full hookup weekend), $50-55 on holidays, $5 processing fee and the required $10 daily vehicle permit (Recreation Passport not valid); no resident split. Confirmed water and sewer (sites 1-131), 205 sites, showers/flush toilets/dump; season May 7-Oct 10 (2027 dates); GoingToCamp booking with a standing 2-night minimum (3 on holidays). Amperage, max rig length (50 ft left) and Wi-Fi (left) not on the county's pages. Phone 231-972-7450 confirmed.
flags: Seasonal share: 103 of the 205 campsites are seasonal (2025 figure; 2027 seasonals already full with a waitlist), i.e. about 50%. Nightly sites remain bookable online, but half the park is seasonal.
Standing 2-night minimum on all campsite reservations (3 on holiday/event weekends), now in booking.min_stay.
